        "Adds the shared email-password-form widget to CardDAV setup, reset focus, a UsernamePassword typedef and a complete widget fixture/browser test. The captured result contains password and rememberPassword, despite the type name; do not invent a username field.",
        "The original new remote-password Forward branch is deliberately a placeholder: OAuth choice and address-book fetch are TODOs and sync receives an empty array. The optional descriptive-name request was adopted locally. Fixed-source tests instead use documentGlobal and pushPrefEnv; these later choices are comparison context. The typedef UsernamePassword still returns only password and rememberPassword.",
        "The original remote-account Forward branch indexes this.#states[this.currentState], while the class declares #currentState and passes currentState into the method. A bounded exact-file check finds this one public-looking spelling among private-field uses. This is an additional reason the placeholder branch cannot establish a completed login flow; no runtime exception is claimed. The later accepted consumer uses stored/OAuth/password decisions and initializeSyncSubview, which belongs to a later phase.",
        "Direct written widget assertions check password focus and empty reset value, disabled/unchecked remember policy, completed config-updated event, and captured password/remember Boolean under both policy values.
